raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to open and extract data from the Datocapital page (registry details) and instead kept returning generic search result listings. This led to repeated searches without progression or authoritative evidence, preventing confirmation of the exact Cayman Islands-registered broadcaster and tying it to the 28 March 2011 launch.
